title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - AdministrativeArea
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/AdministrativeArea. An administrative division, unit, entity, area or region, also referred to as a subnational entity, constituent unit, or country subdivision, delineated for the purpose of administration (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Administrative_division). Subclass of geo:Feature (http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature), itself a subclass of geo:SpatialObject, from which it inherits the topology pattern used throughout SAREF4CITY: a geospatial position (mapped here to the standard NGSI-LD `location` GeoProperty, derived from geo:hasGeometry) and the geo:sfContains / geo:sfWithin containment relationships used to connect an administrative area to the areas it spatially contains or is contained within (e.g. a city containing its neighbourhoods). City, Country, District and Neighbourhood are its four SAREF4CITY subclasses and are modelled as their own candidates, inheriting this same pattern without repeating it.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AdministrativeArea'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/AdministrativeArea' via geo:hasGeometry. GeoJSON reference to the item. Geographical position of the administrative area.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates, in WGS84 order, shaped per the GeoJSON `type` above (a [lon, lat] pair for Point; nested rings/polygons for Polygon/MultiPolygon).

sfContains.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#sfContains'. Other geo:Feature entities (e.g. other AdministrativeArea or CityObject instances) spatially contained within this administrative area.

sfWithin.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#sfWithin'. The geo:Feature (typically a larger AdministrativeArea) that this administrative area is spatially within.
